scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join('..','eval-results','incidents.json'),dst=p.join('public','incidents.json');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('incidents.json refreshed from eval-results')}else if(fs.existsSync(dst)){console.log('using the committed incidents.json snapshot')}else{console.error('no incident data: run `uv run chronotrace eval --arm C --cases all`');process.exit(1)}"
